# AGT-INJ-02

**Does the design use a pattern that limits what injected instructions can do, rather than relying on the model to refuse them?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI agent lens](ai-agent.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | INJ: Injection and trust |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `elements.agent.injection_defence` |

## Rule

Every agent whose input_trust is mixed or untrusted declares an injection_defence other than none or classifier alone.

## Sources

- Beurer-Kellner et al., Design Patterns for Securing LLM Agents against Prompt Injections (2025) (`design-patterns-injection`)
- Debenedetti et al., Defeating Prompt Injections by Design, CaMeL (2025) (`camel`)
- Díaz, Kern and Olive, Google's Approach for Secure AI Agents (2025) (`google-secure-agents`)
